content.stem: 金融行业在交易监控方面高度依赖基于规则的方法来发现可疑活动.基于场景的系统利用技术和算法来识别:(选择三项.)

options.A: 涉及被盗或伪造身份证明的欺诈性身份。
options.B: 涉及在一天中不寻常时间发生的交易的可疑行为。
options.D: 涉及超过一定金额的交易的交易模式。
options.E: 涉及在远离客户通常消费地点发生的交易的异常情况。

content.stem_en: The financial industry relies heavily on rules-based approaches to transaction monitoring to detect suspicious activities. Scenario-based systems use technology and algorithms to identify: (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Fraudulent identities involving stolen or manufactured identification.
options_en.B: Suspicious behavior involving a transaction that occurs at an unusual time of day.
options_en.D: Transaction patterns involving transactions that exceed a certain dollar amount.
options_en.E: Anomalies involving a transaction that occurs far from the customer's usual spending location.
